welcome: Take a breath and sign your mark. Every grand master began by fumbling with parchment just like this.
crafting_table: Four wooden planks give birth to wonders. Treat this bench kindly and it will serve you well.
iron_tools: Stone has its limits, apprentice. True work begins once you pull gray iron from the deep dark.
sleep: Even spellweavers need their rest. A warm blanket keeps the wandering spirits from claiming your weary bones.
flint_knife: Sharp steel is fine for battle, but dinner calls for a gentler, more deliberate edge.
cutting_board: Mind your fingers on the grain. Good preparation makes even bitter roots taste like a feast.
cooking_pot: Set it over the coals and let time do the work. Magic and broth share much in common.
vegetable_soup: Nothing clears a foggy head quite like hot broth after a long day in the woods.
warp_stone: Memory folds space across vast horizons. Keep this close and the road will always shorten.
waystone: Awaken the standing stone, apprentice. It anchors your footsteps across leagues of trackless wild.
team: Solitude breeds eccentric wizards with singed beards. Find comrades who will pull you from your own craters.
claim: Mark your boundaries clearly. Neighbors are far more agreeable when stray fireballs cannot scorch their cabbages.
minimap: Even the wisest stars wander sometimes. Pin your hearth to the parchment so you never walk in circles.
corpse: Flesh fails, but dignity can wait. Pick yourself up and fetch your belongings before the scavengers notice.
hostility_detector: Shadows here have sharp teeth and foul temper. Watch the needle before wandering into dark valleys.
hostility_orb: Spite gathers wherever blood is spilled. Cleanse the land before the shadows take root around your doorstep.
vr_tips: Reach out and feel the grain of the wood. Magic feels remarkably different when held in your hands.
immersive_craft: Shape the pieces with your own grip. There is honest joy in handling the timber yourself.
backpack: Pockets fill fast when you wander. A sturdy sack spares you from leaving treasures in the dirt.
door: Hang a thick oak slab to keep the night wind outside and wandering creepers where they belong.
windows: Magecraft demands good sunlight. Glass keeps the rain off your scrolls while letting the dawn inside.
hearth_home: Four walls and a sturdy roof make all the difference when storms roll across the hills.
ready: You have shelter and full bellies. Now comes the part where we teach the world to listen.
act1_start: Catch the first spark in the dark. Four paths lie ahead, each with its own stubborn mysteries.
worn_notebook: Pages soften with age, but ink remembers. Open it and read how we coax the air to burn.
novice_book: Clumsy fingers write small cantrips first. Hold it tight and speak the syllables without trembling.
scribes_table: Here ideas take physical form upon parchment. Carve the symbols cleanly or face the smoky consequences.
source_gem: Crystallized vitality, violet as twilight. Hold it to the sun and watch the raw power hum inside.
imbuement_chamber: Quiet focus coaxes ambient power into crystal. Patience yields far sweeter magic than brute force ever could.
source_jar: Power spills if left uncontained. Seal it beneath glass until your rituals call for its strength.
sourcelink: Green leaves drink sunlight and breathe pure mana. Plant your crops and let nature feed your work.
mixing_cauldron: Old bog witchery is messy business. Stir the muck clockwise unless you fancy an unexpected bang.
drying_rack: Hang the leaves high away from hungry beetles. A witch never brews with damp herbs.
pestle: Pound the herbs until they yield their oils. Muscle often matters just as much as incantations.
broom_brush: Bind the twigs tight, apprentice. A loose bristle will send you tumbling into a pine tree.
willow_broom: Kick off and feel the wind catch your hem. Just mind the treetop branches on landing.
codex: Ancient gods left heavy words behind. Read them with respect, or at least reasonable caution.
worktable: Chisel cold stone beneath flickering candlelight. Solemn hands shape tools that outlast mortal kingdoms.
research_table: Pour over forgotten texts until your eyes ache. Insight seldom arrives without plenty of spilled ink.
athame: Never use this ritual blade to butter your morning toast, apprentice. It demands solemn focus.
soul_shard: Even dust holds stubborn memories. Wring the remnants from restless bones that refuse to sleep quietly.
inscription_table: Spells etched into parchment must never wander. Steady hands carve runes that hold lightning still.
arcane_essence: Catch the glowing sparks of spent magic drifting through the air before they fade away.
first_scroll: Roll the parchment tight and speak the verse. A single chant can turn the tide of battle.
copper_spell_book: Copper rings true with raw sorcery. Inscribe your favourite cantrips and carry your spells safely.
tf_portal: Drop a bright stone into still blossoms. The dusk realm waits just beyond the shimmering ripple.
naga: Watch the scaled serpent coil through ancient stones, and strike hard when it pauses to turn.
lich: Dusty robes and stolen shields guard that dusty tower. Shatter his illusions and grant him peace.
act1_end: Your foundation is firm, apprentice. Three deeper mysteries beckon, so choose whichever calls to your blood.
arcane_start: Clean geometry and soaring towers await. Walk this road if you prefer precision over muddy boots.
apprentice_book: Your scribbles are growing sharper. The pages now hum with power that rattles your fingertips.
arcane_core: Anchor the central heartbeat of our workshop here so power flows smoothly into your apparatus.
arcane_pedestal: Four pillars to hold your offerings. Symmetry keeps the wild energy from spilling into the floorboards.
enchanting_apparatus: Now the real weaving begins. Focus your mind and watch raw materials transmute into arcane relics.
ritual_brazier: Flames clear away distractions. Feed the embers well when summoning spirits across the ether.
wilden_parts: Beasts of the frozen crags do not yield easily. Gather their remnants to prove your mettle.
wilden_summon: Call the apex predator of the wild. Prepare yourself, for it will not arrive in good humor.
wilden_chimera: Fangs, claws, and freezing wind united as one. Stand your ground and fell the roaring nightmare.
archmage_book: Few wizards ever live to open such bindings. Its pages hum with living starlight.
starbuncle: Hairy little scavengers with swift feet. Give them an honest job and they never stop scurrying.
wixie: Mischief trapped within a copper ring. Put them to work at the cauldron before they pinch silverware.
turret: Never stand guard when magic can watch for you. Point it toward the dark and let fly.
relay: Mana resists travelling through thin air. Guide the glowing currents where you need them most.
fire_focus: Warm your fingers or incinerate a goblin. A proper focus keeps the flame from burning you.
bangle: Woven metal to focus stray currents. Slip it over your wrist and feel your spells steady.
curio_bag: Never clutter your pockets with talismans. Keep your charms organized and ready at a moment notice.
mark_of_mastery: Wear this sigil with pride, apprentice. You have proven yourself far beyond the novice halls.
arcane_anvil: Hammering spells into metal requires arcane resonance. Strike while the rune is bright and malleable.
scroll_forge: Turn molten energy into lasting parchment. A forge like this prints power directly upon paper.
uncommon_ink: Common soot will not hold complex magic. Brew ink that shimmers under the midnight moon.
blank_rune: Carve your intent deep into bare slate so the enchantment never fades with time.
arcane_ingot: Iron refined through sheer will and spellcraft. It rings with a tone that banishes dull iron.
mithril: Dug from the bones of the world. Silver tears that hold enchantments tighter than tempered steel.
iron_spell_book: Iron bindings for a heavier hand. Your spells deserve a sturdier home than paper and string.
upgrade_orb: Reinforce your garments with woven protection. An archmage must look grand while surviving heavy blows.
catacombs: Step quietly into the sunken halls. Ancient dust clings to every corner of these moldering tombs.
dead_king: Topple that moldering monarch from his throne and send his rusty crown into the quiet dark.
mahou_guide: Bloody bargains and glowing circles. Read closely, apprentice, for this discipline forgives no mistakes.
mahou_mortar: Grind materials until the essence separates. Blood magic demands absolute purity in every grain.
powdered_diamond: Gems crushed to glittering dust. Even hardened carbon gives way when pressed with sufficient patience.
attuned_diamond: Infuse the gem dust with your own bloodline. It turns red with hungry mystic potential.
mahoujin: Inscribe the crimson circle upon the flagstones. Power pools within the boundary waiting for your word.
projection: Pull an echo of blade and steel from thin air. Illusions become lethal when sharpened by will.
strengthening: Reinforce mortal sinew with pure mana. You can take a walloping when your flesh turns to stone.
arcane_cross_a: True scholars always borrow from other traditions. Bring back a shadowy secret to broaden your studies.
arcane_cross_b: Even bookish mages need mossy wisdom. Bring something green into your study to balance the intellect.
arcane_cross: All magic springs from a common source. Tie the traditions together and feel the web strengthen.
arcane_final: Command the grand towers with confidence. You stand today as a true master of pure sorcerous arts.
occult_start: Ancient answers wait in the dark for brave souls. Keep your head clear and your pentacles unbroken.
sacrificial_bowl: Spirits expect proper hospitality before negotiation. Set out the dish and prepare your offerings carefully.
white_chalk: Draw your circles with an unwavering hand. Good wards keep unwanted visitors on their own side of the veil.
golden_bowl: Gilded vessels draw prouder entities. Place it at the nexus where both worlds touch.
attuned_gem: Gaze into this crystal to catch whispers from across the veil. The shadows dance when you tilt it.
foliot_book: Vellum treated to hold otherworldly wills. Name the spirit cleanly so it cannot twist your intent.
bound_foliot: Speak the spirit name cleanly into the vellum. Treat them fairly and they will serve you faithfully.
lumberjack: Why swing an axe when a demon enjoys felling timber? Let them clear the forest for you.
iesnium: Metal pulled from across the veil. Smelt the cold ore into bars that defy earthly gravity.
storage_controller: Fold your worldly possessions into pocket dimensions. Never worry about overflowing wooden chests again.
afrit: Flames of the lower realms burn hot. Quench the beast before it sets your beard on fire.
afrit_essence: Fire caught in a flask of glass. Its heat never dies even in the bitterest snowstorm.
encyclopedia: Darker truths require darker bindings. Turn the pages gently lest the shadows nibble your sleeves.
crude_scythe: Reap more than stalks of autumn rye. This curved edge harvests the lingering spirits of the fallen.
soulstone: Dark stone that drinks ambient whispers. Mine it gently from places where the dead linger.
spirit_altar: Balance the spirits upon an altar of polished stone. Let their ethereal energies weave together in harmony.
soul_stained_steel: Temper hot metal in restless spiritual energy. The resulting blade cuts both flesh and phantoms alike.
hallowed_gold: Purity pulled from radiant embers. Gold blessed by spirits shines bright against the creeping dark.
spirit_jar: Trap ethereal flames within glass walls. Spirits settle down once given a tidy jar to inhabit.
spirit_crucible: Melt spiritual essence into concentrated drafts. Watch the fumes rise like colored incense into the night.
totem_base: Runewood carries life deep into the soil. Erect the totem so spirits may gather safely nearby.
gilded_ring: Slip this band of gold onto your finger and feel your magical reserves steady.
dark_wand: Power carved from ominous intent. Point it toward your foes and watch them cower in dread.
dark_altar: Sacred to nocturnal mysteries. Kneel here when you wish to petition the shadows for greater favors.
cursed_ingot: Metal forged with bitter oaths. Handle it with tongs, for the chill sinks deep into bones.
cursed_infuser: Twist common materials with uncanny spite. The resulting crafts carry a truly formidable bite.
dark_robe: Dress for the company you keep, apprentice. Silk steeped in shadow protects against prying moonlight.
blazing_focus: Feed brimstone into this fiery core. Channel your fury into a blinding flare of heat.
vizier: Strike down the grand usurper hiding behind stolen ranks, and scatter his treacherous court.
stone_altar: Chiseled granite dedicated to primordial powers. Pour out your devotion and listen to the cold silence.
crucible: Bubbling brews of gold and ash. Keep the fire steady under the belly of the pot.
arcane_gold: Alchemical gold born from mystical transmutations. It possesses virtues that common miners could never comprehend.
soul_enchanter: Transfer the passions of the departed into steel. No blade cuts keener than one driven by regret.
lesser_soul_gem: Hold this glass vessel to the candle to see faint violet light swirling inside.
reaper_scythe: Reap the twilight harvest with solemn purpose. No crescent steel cuts keener than this blade.
occult_cross_a: Wisdom knows no taboo, apprentice. Steal a bright page from the scholars to steady your shadowy crafts.
occult_cross_b: Nature and decay are two sides of one coin. Bring living green into the tomb to complete it.
occult_cross: Walk between worlds without fear. The bridge is crossed when both light and shadow answer your call.
occult_final: Part the veil at your command, apprentice. You have mastered the hidden arts of spirit and shadow.
natural_start: Listen to the moss and the root. The earth breathes slowly, but its strength outlasts stone towers.
na_book: Bark and vines make an honest teacher. Read how sunlight weaves through the forest canopy above.
gold_fiber: Spin gold into common green moss. The tree will drink the shimmer until its leaves turn bright.
gold_leaf: Leaves kissed by gilded light. Gather them gently before the autumn breeze scatters them across hills.
wood_stand: Carved pedestals to hold natural offerings. Arrange them in the meadow where the wind blows softly.
nature_altar: Build an altar where roots run deep. The forest pours its vitality into items resting here.
infused_iron: Iron softened by green life. It bends like supple willow without ever losing its cutting edge.
eye: Peer through this lens to see the living pulse. The world glows bright where nature thrives.
flower_generator: Blossoms drink the dew and sing silent songs. Plant a vibrant meadow to nourish the surrounding land.
offering_table: Lay gifts upon the mossy stone. The ancient spirits of the wild return generosity with gifts.
sky_ingot: Metal kissed by clouds and morning wind. Light as a gull feather, yet durable as granite.
conversion_catalyst: Place it beneath the altar to shift its balance. Wild power twists into stranger, deeper shapes.
book_of_shadows: Old hedgerow remedies recorded by hand. Every brew inside was paid for in scratched hands and stings.
selenite: Moonlit crystals buried beneath peat. They catch the evening glow and hold it until the dawn.
crystal_ball: Gaze into cloudy quartz until visions clear. The future is fickle, but hints appear to patient eyes.
crow_ankh: Corvid eyes watch over your back on lonely roads when you wear this feathered charm.
blood_sigil: Offer a single drop of your own vitality to seal the ancient pact.
sage_bundle: Sweet smoke cleanses foul humours from the hut. Burn the dried bundle whenever night air grows sour.
witch_altar: Adorn the hearth with rowan twigs and antlers. Power gathers wherever a witch honors the wild world.
witch_oven: Clay walls trap mystic vapors within. Catch the precious fumes before they vanish into autumn clouds.
distillery: Condense herbal essences drop by amber drop. One thimbleful contains the virtue of a whole meadow.
kettle: Boil roots and bark over gentle embers. A quiet kitchen is often the deadliest laboratory of all.
witch_cauldron: Fill it with water and toss in your gatherings. Stir well while the broth turns bright emerald.
ritual_chalk: Grind gypsum with fragrant sap. Trace your warding lines before summoning wild things from the bracken.
mutandis: Alchemical pollen that coaxes seeds into bizarre blooms. Toss a pinch and see what sprouts instantly.
poppet: Cloth and straw bound with thread and hair. What befalls the doll echoes upon the master.
enchanted_broom: Soar over tree canopies on seasoned ash wood. Just mind the migratory geese on your travels.
attuned_stone: Let the stone soak in running river water. It stores pure natural energy until you need it.
divination_rod: Hazel twigs twitch and dip whenever rich veins hide beneath the damp soil.
calcination_oven: Reduce matter to its fundamental white ash. From pure dust, new wonders can be assembled.
liquefaction: Melt stubborn ores into golden alchemical liquor. The cauldron softens even the coldest underground iron.
distiller: Separate the philosophical principles of salt, sulfur, and mercury. Refine each until they glow with purity.
incubator: Warm the vessel like a brooding hen. New alchemical life takes form in this steady heat.
mercury: Quicksilver shards that dance across the palm. Liquid metal holds the spark of perpetual change.
natural_cross_a: Scholarly geometry has its uses, apprentice. Blend a tidy arcane formula with your messy green garden.
natural_cross_b: Even mushrooms grow best in graveyard dirt. Bring a shadow relic into the forest to fertilize roots.
natural_cross: Unify your knowledge and let the forest blossom around you. The green wood welcomes all honest seekers.
minoshroom: Deep in the humid maze, the beast bellows. Bring an axe and claim its seasoned stew.
natural_final: Walk the world as an honored warden of nature while the ancient grove bows to your footsteps.
act3_start: Leave the mortal threshold far behind you. Step forward, apprentice, and claim your ascendant mantle.
gem_cutting: Facet raw jewels until they catch blinding light. A clean cut amplifies every facet of enchantment.
gem: Starlight caught in crystal matrix. Socket this into your plate to feel sudden, tremendous power surge.
socketing: Carve empty hollows into tempered steel. Prepare your weapons to seat the finest gems you discover.
augmenting: Enhance the hidden virtues of your relics. Even masterwork gear has room for another subtle twist.
reforging: Hammer the blade anew on the anvil of chance. Seek an affix worthy of a true archmage.
salvaging: Break down useless trinkets into mystic dust. Nothing goes to waste in a thrifty wizard laboratory.
enhancement: Push enchantments past their natural mortal limits. Break the old boundaries and bend the rules today.
hellshelf: Books bound in brimstone and soaked in lava. Their heat drives your enchanting table to frenzy.
seashelf: Spines smelling of brine and sunken reefs. Oceanic serenity steadies wild spells upon your altar.
researching_table: Examine strange relics plucked from dusty ruins. Unravel their mechanisms before strapping them to your belt.
magic_mirror: Peer into the silver glass to step across leagues and return straight to your hearth.
roller_skates: Whizz across flagstones like a swooping bat. My knees ache just watching you glide by, apprentice.
relic_xp: Spiritual wisdom bottled in amber glass. Drink deep to unlock the mysteries sleeping in ancient baubles.
aether: Step through falling water into blinding clouds. The sky islands drift where mortals were never meant to tread.
aether_altar: Charge sacred relics in glowing solar light. Heavenly ambrosia purges the grime of the lower world.
zanite: Purple crystal mined from cloudstone crags. It hardens under stress, making armour fit for storm winds.
slider: Dodge the sliding block of angry stone, then crack its core with a pickaxe.
valkyrie_queen: Her silver wings flash like lightning. Face her in honourable combat and win her royal respect.
sun_spirit: Eternal flame burning at the golden summit. Deflect his fiery spheres back into his blazing face.
deep_aether: Venture beyond the familiar floating shores. Stranger skies and darker cloud banks await your wandering steps.
brass_dungeon: Gears and bronze buried within floating rock. Watch your step, for automated defenses never sleep.
aether_champion: You have conquered the highest heavens. Wear the champion laurels with pride beneath the sun.
otherside: Descend into the sunken city where sculk spreads. Light the deep portal and gaze into the void.
warden: Blind horror tracking the faintest footstep. Silence your breath, apprentice, or be broken in the dark.
echo_shard: Silence repeats itself in these resonant fragments. Forge them into relics that swallow all noise.
heart_of_deep: Cold stone that pulses like a frozen heart. The darkness itself coagulates within this heavy prize.
cornelia: Board the rotting deck of the frozen sea captain and lay her sorrowful ghost to rest.
maze_mother: Chittering terrors crawl within the stone labyrinth. Slay the brood queen and claim her cobwebbed hoard.
undergarden: Descend into perpetual twilight beneath the bedrock where giant fungi and pale rot flourish.
forgotten_guardian: Ancient bronze waking from subterranean slumber. Dodge its heavy swings and reduce it to scrap metal.
bfb_pirate: Show this salt-crusted scoundrel that true sorcery easily trumps rusty cutlasses.
bfb_kraken: Tentacles lash out from black ocean depths. Sever the beast arms before it drags you down.
bfb_sandworm: Watch for rippling dunes before the leviathan strikes, then aim right for the open maw.
bfb_yeti: Keep your fire spells ready when scaling these frozen peaks. Dodge his furious charges.
bfb_underworld: Overwhelm the dark knight with magical force before his obsidian blade finds your ribs.
bfb_dragon: Scales of molten rock and wings of sulfur. Bring him down from the sky with freezing cantrips.
gate_minoshroom: Fell the bull in his maze of roots. The outer borders of the twilight forest unlock.
hydra: Cut off one head and two roar back. Cauterize the fiery necks before you are swallowed whole.
knight_phantom: Six armored ghosts wheeling through the banquet hall. Parry their flying axes and banish their spirits.
ur_ghast: Weeping behemoth perched atop the dark tower. Charge the carminite traps and tear down his sorrow.
wither: Three skulls chanting death in the cavern. Shield yourself well before the wither star is born.
act3_end: Every trial has led you to this precipice. Beyond this threshold waits the ruin of whole civilizations.
finale_start: Etch your name into eternity as the world trembles. Slay the cataclysmic horrors stalking the realm.
ender_dragon: Clip the leathery wings circling high obsidian pillars and grant eternal freedom to the End.
cata_ignis: Cool the flaming monarch in his arena of ash with your sharpest, most unyielding frost.
cata_harbinger: Steel demon powered by ancient forgotten furnaces. Dodge its searing laser and dismantle the rusted engine.
cata_leviathan: Colossus of the ocean abyss. Slay the sea titan and claim mastery over the crushing tides.
cata_ender_guardian: Sentinel of the shattered citadel. Teleporting blades cannot save it from a prepared battle archmage.
cata_monstrosity: Molten netherite walking on iron legs. Bring down the walking forge before it flattens the earth.
cata_maledictus: Frozen malice bound within an icy crypt. Break his icy crown and melt his frozen heart.
cata_ancient_remnant: Stone titan slumbering beneath desert sands. Crack open its ancient ribcage and smash the cursed core.
cata_scylla: Weave between the strikes of the multi-headed terror and bring down the queen of the high acropolis.
alpha_yeti: King of the blizzards in his frosty den. Bring him down before his avalanches bury you.
snow_queen: Her ice palace pierces the freezing sky. Shatter her icy sled and claim her northern bow.
apostle: Silence the dark prophet preaching Nether ruin once and for all with radiant holy fury.
ender_keeper: Guardian of forgotten void vaults. Teach this spectral jailer that no door stays shut before magic.
heresiarch: Master of twisted rituals and forbidden blasphemy. End his profane rites with blinding white fire.
capstone: You have surpassed me, apprentice. Stand tall as Archmage, for the realms are safe in your hands.
guild_join: Wizards who only blow things up get boring quickly. Take up a trowel and build something lasting.
guild_well: Every settlement begins with clean water. Dig deep and build a handsome roof to shelter the bucket.
guild_market: Trade brings coins and strange gossip from distant lands. Set up colorful awnings for traveling merchants.
guild_tower: Raise a proud spire to watch the stars and make lesser wizards turn green with envy.
guild_library: Shelves upon shelves of dusty tomes. Just make sure the roof never leaks on my favorite folios.
guild_garden: Tending herbs within quiet stone walls soothes an overtaxed magical mind.
guild_bridge: Span the rushing waters with sturdy stonework. A good arch stands long after kings turn to dust.
guild_tavern: Every adventure begins around a warm hearth. Keep the cider sweet and the benches sturdy for travelers.
guild_portal: Dimensional rifts deserve respectful architecture. House your gateways inside an arched hall of polished granite.
guild_dock: Where river meets the salt sea. Tie off a rowboat and listen to gulls calling at sunrise.
guild_statue: Carve something inspiring from gray stone. Try not to make the nose too large, my dear apprentice.
guild_lighthouse: Keep a bright lamp burning atop coastal cliffs when violent squalls blow in from sea.
guild_greenhouse: Glass arches to trap morning warmth. Exotic cuttings thrive when sheltered from biting winter frosts.
guild_stable: Warm straw and sweet oats for faithful steeds. Even pegasi appreciate a clean stall after long flights.
guild_skyship: Moor your vessel high above the chimneys. Nothing announces a wizard town like an airship at anchor.
guild_wonder: Show the whole realm what a determined coven can build when imagination takes flight.
computer: Metal thinking through lightning pulses. It feels like mechanical sorcery, but it obeys simple logic.
first_program: Type your greeting and watch letters appear on the screen. It is remarkably satisfying to behold.
disk_drive: Magnetic platters that store your thoughts. Keep magnets away from them, or watch your data evaporate.
printer: Pounding ink onto parchment without a quill. It makes copying long manuscripts almost pleasantly effortless.
speaker: Compose a jaunty tune on this brass horn to celebrate our latest lab triumphs.
turtle: Order this clockwork automaton on treads to scuttle about and do your bidding.
mining_turtle: It digs square tunnels without complaining about soot. My old back is immensely grateful for this machine.
wireless_modem: Spreading messages on invisible ether waves. Talk to your machines across the valley without shouting.
pocket: Carry a calculating engine in your palm so you can check scripts while exploring damp caverns.
monitor: Luminescent glass to display your readings. Line them up side by side for a truly commanding view.
peripheral_casing: Sturdy housing for intricate mechanical adapters. Craft it well so delicate components never shake loose inside.
chat_box: Now the machine can broadcast across the realm. Program it politely so it does not annoy neighbors.
doorbell: No more wandering guests startling me mid-brew thanks to this polite chime.
player_detector: Sensors that notice your presence instantly. It knows when you walk through the doorway every time.
env_detector: Reading wind, rain, and temperature from a copper node. Nature yields its numbers to careful observers.
inventory_manager: Sorting chests by hand is a young person chore. Let brass fingers move your baubles around.
storage_terminal: Browse your sprawling hoards from a single panel. Even my chaotic collection looks tidy here.
inventory_connector: Tie multiple crates into a single unified network. No more running across rooms looking for cobblestone.
inventory_cable: Run cables beneath the floorboards, apprentice. A tidy workshop keeps visitors from tripping on copper coils.
crafting_terminal: Pull materials and shape them at the same desk. Efficiency makes even tedious chores pass like a breeze.
dashboard: Glass screens reporting chest tallies at a glance. Even an old archmage appreciates tidy inventories.
tp_gpu: Slot this board in so your computer can paint crisp charts and glowing graphics.
tp_monitor: Spread your work across a grand display that even my tired eyes can read clearly.
tp_keyboard: Clicking keys that answer every tap. Typing orders into the terminal is faster than chanting incantations.
atlas_start: Pack sturdy walking boots, apprentice. Wonders far beyond the horizon await your curious gaze.
explorers_compass: Follow this magnetic needle when searching for forgotten underground strongholds.
natures_compass: Let this needle swing toward fragrant blossoms or snowy pines so you can find any biome.
lootr_1: Take your rightful share from this enchanted chest and leave something behind for comrades.
lootr_10: Ten caches uncovered in dark places. Your pockets are growing heavier with forgotten silver coins.
lootr_25: You have quite the nose for buried loot after prying open twenty-five troves.
lootr_100: At this rate, we will need another cellar just to store all your dungeon plunder.
dungeon_zombie: Cobwebs, mossy cobble, and groaning undead. A classic underground crawl that never goes out of fashion.
dungeon_skeleton: Rattling bones and snapping bowstrings. Keep your shield raised as you clear out the archers.
dungeon_spider: Sticky webs catching your sleeves in the dark. Bring a sharp blade and watch the ceilings.
dungeon_all: You have explored every moldering tomb in the province. Nothing down there can surprise you anymore.
tavern: Warm your boots by the hearth fire and trade rumors with traveling merchants.
witch_villa: An opulent manse tucked between willow trees. Mind the bubbling pots and watch out for flying brooms.
illager_manor: Dark oak halls filled with vindictive outcasts. Clear the manor and claim their stolen gold.
lone_citadel: Who built this solitary tower to brave the mountain winds, and what relics linger inside?
nether: Stepping through obsidian into burning sulfur. Keep your canteen full, apprentice, for water boils away here.
fortress: Black brick bridges spanning lakes of lava. Keep your distance from blazes and floating ghasts.
bastion: Piglin citadels carved from gilded blackstone. Tread carefully, and wear gold unless you fancy a brawl.
nether_keep: Search these brutal black vaults for treasures forged in unquenchable infernal fires.
end: Step carefully across these pale drifting islands, apprentice, for the void hungers below.
end_city: Purple towers defying gravity over empty air. Climb the spire and claim the wings of flight.
end_castle: Only true masters dare cross the threshold of this citadel crowning the starry void.
atlas_tf: Perpetual dusk beneath ancient oak trees. Watch out for mischievous goblins hiding in the tall grass.
magic_map: Paper that charts the whimsical woodland paths. Landmarks reveal themselves as you tread beneath canopies.
atlas_undergarden: Breathe shallowly as you explore this cavernous realm, for fungal spores drift thick as fog.
adventuring_time: From sunlit savannas to frozen ice spikes. You have walked every corner of this beautiful world.
bestiary_start: Study the wild beasts before they catch you off guard, for monsters grow fiercer with every league.
detector: Listen to the clicking needle, apprentice. It warns you when ferocious beasts prowl nearby territory.
glasses: Slip them on to inspect monster weaknesses. Seeing through their tricks saves you many painful bruises.
kill_first: They carry strange traits now, do they? Strike hard and remember what works against their mutations.
kill_5_traits: Five uncanny blessings upon one wretched beast. You handled that fight with admirable composure, apprentice.
kill_10_traits: An absolute nightmare of fangs and curses. Slaying that monstrosity proves your battlefield instincts are sharp.
sanity: Drink the soothing draught when paranoia creeps in. A clear mind is your best defense against madness.
chaos_ingot: Metal forged from raw monstrous unpredictability. It ripples with chaotic potential in your trembling tongs.
miracle: Survival against impossible odds is no accident. You have triumphed over the cruelest beast in these lands.
frostmaw: Do not wake this sleeping behemoth unless you are thoroughly prepared to dodge hurled ice.
wroughtnaut: Wait for his massive axe to stick in the flagstones before striking from behind.
umvuthi: Sun priest of the high savanna. Watch for his solar flares and strike between his sacred chants.
sculptor: Smash his living statues before they surround you on the windswept mountain peak.
pumpkinhead: Knock the wicked grin off this autumn terror and turn him into compost.
bonescaller: Rattling general commanding armies of calcium. Cut down the commander and his skeletal army crumbles.
krampus: He comes for wicked apprentices who neglect their studies. Show him that your spells pack quite a punch.
hearth_start: Every grand spell begins over a hot fire. A well-fed apprentice casts far better than a starving one.
skillet: Sizzle garlic and butter until the scent fills the kitchen. Good food warms the soul after hard battles.
stove: Keep the coals banked and the bricks hot so your cauldrons simmer steadily.
cabinet: Neat shelves for spices and jars. An organized kitchen is just as important as an orderly spellbook.
rice: Paddy fields glistening in the afternoon sun. Harvest the grain and let it dry on clean mats.
tomato: Plump red fruit heavy on the vine. Sweet and tangy, perfect for rich simmering pasta sauces.
cabbage: Crisp green heads that weather chilly autumn mornings. Shred them into slaws or simmer them in broth.
onion: Peel back the papery skin and wipe away tears. No savory dish is complete without a sweet onion.
meal_beef_stew: Tender beef and root vegetables swimming in brown gravy. This dish puts iron right back into weary bones.
meal_chicken_soup: Sip this steaming broth to cure chills, sniffles, and sour moods after cold rains.
meal_fried_rice: Toss the grains in a smoking hot skillet. Quick, flavorful, and makes wonderful use of yesterday supper.
meal_pasta_with_meatballs: Hearty noodles tossed in rich tomato sauce. Eat your fill, for spellcraft burns plenty of calories.
meal_fish_stew: Fresh catch simmered with garden herbs and cream. The scent alone brings half the village running.
meal_ratatouille: Summer vegetables layered with meticulous care. It looks like a painting and tastes even better.
meal_stuffed_pumpkin_block: Baked inside its own sweet shell. A grand centerpiece for crisp autumn evenings around the fire.
meal_shepherds_pie_block: Savory minced meat blanketed with golden mashed potatoes. Pure hearty comfort after a long dungeon crawl.
feast: Set the platter down and summon your coven. Magic is meant to be shared over hot chicken.
